process CELLTYPIST {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/db/db26a106d81b1b9dee9d3ce7223c13019a3b8e0ee6797b6197c402637f704017/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/celltypist:1.7.1--81458d01ea674d65'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(h5ad), path(over_clustering), path(gene_file), path(cell_file)
    tuple val(meta2), path(model)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_predicted_labels.csv")  , optional: true, emit: predicted_labels
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_decision_matrix.csv")   , optional: true, emit: decision_matrix
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_probability_matrix.csv"), optional: true, emit: probability_matrix
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_annotation_result.xlsx"), optional: true, emit: xlsx
    tuple val(meta), path("*.pdf")                           , optional: true, emit: plots
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('celltypist'), eval("python3 -c 'import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version(\"celltypist\"))'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_celltypist

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def over_clustering_arg = over_clustering ? "--over-clustering ${over_clustering}" : ''
    def gene_file_arg = gene_file ? "--gene-file ${gene_file}" : ''
    def cell_file_arg = cell_file ? "--cell-file ${cell_file}" : ''
    """
    # Home is read-only in some containers, so keep CellTypist's cache and plotting files in the work directory
    export CELLTYPIST_FOLDER=./celltypist_cache
    export MPLCONFIGDIR=./tmp/mpl
    export NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=./tmp/numba

    celltypist \\
        ${args} \\
        ${over_clustering_arg} \\
        ${gene_file_arg} \\
        ${cell_file_arg} \\
        --indata ${h5ad} \\
        --model ${model} \\
        --outdir . \\
        --prefix ${prefix}_
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def tables = args.contains('--xlsx') ? "${prefix}_annotation_result.xlsx" : "${prefix}_predicted_labels.csv ${prefix}_decision_matrix.csv ${prefix}_probability_matrix.csv"
    def plots = args.contains('--plot-results') ? "${prefix}_predicted_labels.pdf" : ''
    """
    touch ${tables} ${plots}
    """
}

name: "nf-core/celltypist"
description: "Automated cell type annotation of single-cell RNA-seq data using a pre-trained\
  \ CellTypist model"
keywords:
- "single-cell"
- "scrna-seq"
- "cell type annotation"
- "classification"
tools:
- celltypist:
    description: "A tool for semi-automatic cell type annotation."
    homepage: "https://www.celltypist.org"
    documentation: "https://celltypist.readthedocs.io"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/Teichlab/celltypist"
    doi: "10.1126/science.abl5197"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:celltypist"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - h5ad:
      type: "file"
      description: "Log1p-normalised expression matrix with gene symbols (h5ad, csv,\
        \ txt, tsv, tab or mtx)"
      pattern: "*.{h5ad,csv,txt,tsv,tab,mtx,mtx.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3590"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  - over_clustering:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional text file with one over-clustering label per cell, used\
        \ with `--majority-voting`"
      pattern: "*.{txt,csv,tsv}"
      optional: true
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  - gene_file:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional text file with one gene per line, for matrix market input"
      pattern: "*.{txt,tsv}"
      optional: true
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  - cell_file:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional text file with one cell per line, for matrix market input"
      pattern: "*.{txt,tsv}"
      optional: true
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing model information\ne.g. `[ id:'Immune_All_Low'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - model:
      type: "file"
      description: "Pre-trained CellTypist model"
      pattern: "*.pkl"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2333"
output:
  predicted_labels:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_predicted_labels.csv:
        type: "file"
        optional: true
        description: "Optional predicted cell type label for each cell"
        pattern: "*predicted_labels.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  decision_matrix:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_decision_matrix.csv:
        type: "file"
        optional: true
        description: "Optional decision scores of each cell for each cell type in\
          \ the model"
        pattern: "*decision_matrix.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  probability_matrix:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_probability_matrix.csv:
        type: "file"
        optional: true
        description: "Optional probability of each cell belonging to each cell type\
          \ in the model"
        pattern: "*probability_matrix.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  xlsx:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_annotation_result.xlsx:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional Excel workbook with all result tables, written when\
          \ `--xlsx` is given"
        pattern: "*.xlsx"
        optional: true
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3620"
  plots:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.pdf':
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional plots of the prediction results, written when `--plot-results`\
          \ is given"
        pattern: "*.pdf"
        optional: true
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3508"
  versions_celltypist:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - celltypist:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python3 -c 'import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version("celltypist"))':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - celltypist:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python3 -c 'import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version("celltypist"))':
        type: "eval"
